canonical_project: Free Senegal Diamniadio data centre (Tier III)
notes: AXIAN group release (May 2022) states Free will build/operate Avanti's HYLAS 4 gateway from its Tier III data centre facility in Diamniadio; Satnews (May 2023) confirms the gateway's second phase completed and hosted at Free's Tier III Diamniadio facility; Avanti secured HYLAS 4 gateway authorisation Mar 2024 (Avanti page). The Avanti gateway is tenant evidence at Free's DC, not a separate facility.
